_comment: dry run (provisional parts): v6g values carried over, not re-measured in this run; the wording of ten fields is new (ambiguity_fixes)

Coupled limits of shell edition v6g. Angles in degrees, offsets from the rest pose, left-written joint names (right leg: same numbers, mirrored conventions). A pose is inside the validated space when every box it belongs to AND every rule below holds. Exact triangle distance >= 2.5 mm between parts of different links; tested by sampling, not proven.

v8 (20-joint Kobi, 2026-11-25): derived from coupled_limits_v7.json by scripts/make_coupled_limits_v8.py with the frozen value 0 put into every rule (waist_yaw, L_arm_yaw, R_arm_yaw, L_wrist, R_wrist); see config/coupled_limits_v8_changes.json. No range is widened.

rules.definition: omega = waist_yaw for the right leg and -waist_yaw for the left leg; waist_yaw is frozen at 0 in the 20-joint edition, so omega = 0 for both legs
evaluation_order: 1. waist_yaw is frozen at 0 (inside the old range -4.5..4.5, so the old range violation never happens)
2. omega = waist_yaw (right leg) or -waist_yaw (left leg) = 0 for both legs
3. omega <= 0.75: the rule is inactive, hip_yaw <= inactive_hip_yaw_limit_deg (15.0); the step table of the 25-joint edition (omega above 0.75) can never be reached and is not part of this file
4. the right-leg table is used for both legs: not applicable, there is no table
rules.text: With the waist frozen at 0 this rule is the single limit hip_yaw <= 15.0 for each leg (the value the 25-joint checker used at waist 0). Dropped fields of the 25-joint rule: range, yaw_max_by_omega_step_function, step_rule, measured_breakpoints_last_passing_yaw_before_margin, margin_deg, pair, waist_alone, tested_with, files, joints_by_side.

rules.inequality: ankle_pitch <= table(knee), straight line between the points, knee <= 35: 24
rules.negative_ankle_side: ankle_pitch >= -24 for knee 0..60 (lower limit of every box with a knee entry, sampled with the box)
rules.outside_knee_range: outside the validated combined space (single-joint poses only)

rules.applies_to: each arm, all three joints (arm_yaw frozen at 0)

tested_with.note: the v7 boxes are rectangles measured over arm_yaw -43.75..45; arm_yaw = 0 lies inside the measured yaw range of every box, so the pitch, roll and elbow ranges stay valid; not re-measured for the 20-joint shell

rules.arm_boundary_text: boxes are closed intervals; a pose with shoulder roll on a shared boundary (2, 5, 10, 12.5, 15, 20) must satisfy both neighbouring boxes

rules.waist_precondition_frozen: waist_yaw is frozen at 0, inside the old precondition [-4.5, 4.5]; the precondition always holds and is not checked

rules.text: limits of one joint measured with all other joints at rest; they decide only a pose in which exactly one joint differs from the rest pose; boxes and rules decide every other pose

added_from_readme_v6g_section5.note: shell-alone column of README_v6g.md section 5; not in coupled_limits_v6g.json

rules.applies_when: exactly one joint differs from the rest pose
rules.precedence: boxes and rules win over single-joint limits for poses with two or more joints off rest

rules.applies_to: each arm, in every one of the seven arm boxes; left-written numbers, the right arm uses the same numbers with neck_yaw_toward_arm = -neck_yaw
rules.not_in_rule: arm_yaw and elbow (the upper sleeves that touch the head sit on the upper-arm link, which they do not move; the distal parts were measured in the verification and never came under 2.5 mm before these)
rules.neck_yaw_toward_arm: neck_yaw for the left arm, -neck_yaw for the right arm (positive = head turned toward that arm's side)
evaluation_order: 1. the pose must be inside the old arm box of its shoulder roll and the neck box (neck_nod for |neck_yaw| < 45, neck_turn from 45 to 90)
3. on each of the three axes take the nearest node at or below and the nearest node at or above the value (a value on a node: that node only; outside the node range: the end node)
4. roll_cap = the smallest table value among those (up to 8) nodes
5. roll_cap below 0: this shoulder pitch is not allowed with this neck at any roll; otherwise shoulder_roll must be <= roll_cap

table.roll_cap_meaning: 72 = no limit beyond the box (roll box ends at 72); -1 = not allowed at any roll; index order [shoulder_pitch][neck_yaw_toward_arm][neck_pitch]

map.pairs_measured: upper sleeve front/back against head shells L/R and white face L/R

jacket.where: L_shoulder:motor/L_shoulder | torso:shell/Jacket_back | pose L pitch 30.0 roll 69.0 neck 7.5,0.0

status: dry run (provisional parts): v6g values carried over, not re-measured in this run; the wording of ten fields is new (ambiguity_fixes) | v7 (final): the rule arm_head is part of this file (the MuJoCo builder fails when it is missing) | v8: derived from coupled_limits_v7.json with five joints frozen at 0; not re-measured against the shell geometry (the 20-joint poses are a subset of the poses measured for v7)

ambiguity_fixes.old: table entry 0.75 -> 16.5 sat in a table whose step_rule says it starts above 0.75, and 16.5 has no 0.5 degree margin like the other entries; a program could read it as a step, as a margin-less limit, or apply it to negative omega
ambiguity_fixes.new: the 0.75 entry is removed from the table; the table starts at 1.0. Separate field inactive_at_or_below_omega = 0.75: there the rule does not limit anything (the hip yaw limit is the leg box's own, see M5). The measured 0.75 value stays only under measured_breakpoints

ambiguity_fixes.old: omega 4.5000001 has no table entry and the JSON did not say that the waist range check must run first
ambiguity_fixes.new: evaluation_order lists three steps: (1) |waist_yaw| <= 4.5 (closed, tolerance 1e-9) else the pose violates waist_with_legs.range and no table is read; (2) omega = waist for the right leg, -waist for the left leg; (3) omega <= 0.75 -> inactive, else hip_yaw <= table value of the first breakpoint at or above omega. The table is defined for 0.75 < omega <= 4.5 only

ambiguity_fixes.old: joints were written hip_yaw, hip_roll without side next to L_hip_yaw, R_hip_yaw and a side-less hip_roll in single_joint_limits; a lookup by name failed or hit one side only
ambiguity_fixes.new: every joint that has a side is written with its side (L_/R_) everywhere: joints_by_side {L: [waist_yaw, L_hip_yaw, L_hip_roll], R: [waist_yaw, R_hip_yaw, R_hip_roll]}; single_joint_limits is rewritten with L_ and R_ keys for every sided joint (right values equal to the left ones except R_hip_yaw, as measured)

ambiguity_fixes.where: applies_to / _comment 'right leg: same numbers, mirrored conventions'
ambiguity_fixes.old: the sentence holds only if the right hip yaw axis is (0,0,-1) as in the two models checked; the walking environment model was not checked
ambiguity_fixes.new: sign_convention lists the axis of every sided joint copied from config/kinematics_kobifit_v5.json at write time (with the file's sha256): a right joint value is the value of the mirror-image pose of the left joint because the axes of yaw, roll and wrist joints are mirrored in that file. Any model that uses these limits must show the same axes; a model with other axes must flip the signs of exactly those joints

ambiguity_fixes.old: the source says a pose must obey every box it belongs to; a checker reading 'inside one box is enough' and one reading 'both neighbours' disagreed on 372 of 6570 boundary poses
ambiguity_fixes.new: boxes are closed intervals; a pose whose shoulder roll lies exactly on a shared boundary belongs to both neighbouring boxes and must satisfy BOTH (intersection, strict side). Written as arm_boundary_rule = 'closed_both_neighbours_intersection'

ambiguity_fixes.old: the nested boxes were read as 'the box with the narrowest yaw range applies at |yaw| = 45', i.e. the looser pitch limit 11.25 at exactly 45 degrees (not the strict side)
ambiguity_fixes.new: neck_nod applies for |yaw| < 45 (open); at |yaw| = 45 exactly and above only neck_turn applies (pitch -14..7.0). Strict side. The v6g corner measurement (45, 11.25) passed; this dry run measures that corner again, a later edition may move the boundary only on that measured evidence

ambiguity_fixes.old: the source says only waist_inside [-4.5, 4.5]; it was read as 'outside means a neck rule violation'
ambiguity_fixes.new: waist_inside is a precondition of the neck boxes, closed interval [-4.5, 4.5]; a pose outside it is reported as violating waist_with_legs.range (the body joint range), not as a neck-rule violation. The neck boxes are only defined for such poses

ambiguity_fixes.where: knee_ankle_table ends and negative ankle side
ambiguity_fixes.old: knee above 60 took the end value 10.75; the negative ankle side was not constrained because the source said it was verified for knee 20..60 only
ambiguity_fixes.new: the table is defined for knee 0..60 (the range of every leg box with a knee entry). Knee above 60 or below 0 is outside the validated combined space (single-joint poses only, see single_joint_limits). Negative ankle side: ankle_pitch >= -24 for knee 0..60, the lower limit of the boxes (every box that has a knee entry carries ankle_pitch down to -24 and was sampled)

ambiguity_fixes.where: waist_with_legs, omega at or below 0.75 or negative: 16.5 (single-joint limit) versus 15 (largest hip yaw in any leg box)
ambiguity_fixes.old: model took 16.5 (the 0.75 table entry); the source says 'no limit beyond the box, 16.5 at most'; the leg boxes stop at 15.0
ambiguity_fixes.new: for omega <= 0.75 (including negative omega) hip_yaw is limited by the box the leg is in, and no box allows more than 15.0, so 15.0 is the limit (stricter than 16.5). 16.5 stays only in single_joint_limits (shell alone, other joints at rest)

ambiguity_fixes.old: the entries are ranges, not coupled rules; the program stored them as information and did not test them
ambiguity_fixes.new: single_joint_limits are measured with ALL OTHER joints at rest and apply only to a pose in which exactly one joint differs from the rest pose. A pose with two or more joints off rest is judged by the boxes and rules only. Precedence: where a box is wider than a single-joint limit (the self-check lists them: shoulder pitch and arm yaw of the raised-arm boxes) the box wins. They are not outer limits

applies_to: each limb as written in the rules; right-side numbers are the mirror-image pose (axes in sign_convention.axes)

reading_rule: 1. the pose must be inside the old arm box of its shoulder roll and the neck box (neck_nod for |neck_yaw| < 45, neck_turn from 45 to 90)
3. on each of the three axes take the nearest node at or below and the nearest node at or above the value (a value on a node: that node only; outside the node range: the end node)
4. roll_cap = the smallest table value among those (up to 8) nodes
5. roll_cap below 0: this shoulder pitch is not allowed with this neck at any roll; otherwise shoulder_roll must be <= roll_cap
